note: Per-model defaults for HelmApply. `strength` ranges are relative to the axis vector's own scale, which is model-specific — always confirm with 1-2 renders (start at `default`). `tested: false` marks per-model defaults that are not yet verified.

models.evidence: Measured 2026-10-16: axis norm ~3000-4000; λ 0.01-0.3 = monotonic lighting/mood shift, subject preserved; λ>=1 destroys the frame.

Measured 2026-10-16: axis norm ~19; layer 0 destroys the image; layers 9-21 give clean, subject-preserving, monotonic control (green-magenta axis tested). HelmProbe 2026-10-17: the empty-vs-packed separation peaks at block 0 (global) and block 7 (middle band) - the probe is a profile, not a picker; band 9-21 remains the rendered result (docs/EXPERIMENTS.md D).
